headline: Single-cell multiomics links transcriptional states to clinical and tumour features
label: Single Cell Transcriptomic Signature Discovery
summary: Multimodal single-cell and bulk profiling now ties transcriptional and epigenetic states to prognosis and clonal architecture.
synthesis: The dominant thread is pairing single-cell or tissue-state readouts with a second modality or clinical axis to attach a state to a biological or prognostic meaning. The exploratory MOFA+ integration of paired scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq from two NMIBC patients yields a BCG-associated HSPC latent factor with an adverse prognostic association in tumour. Droplet-MT jointly profiles transcriptome and methylome in ~10,000-cell libraries to reconstruct hematopoietic clones from epimutations. ARID1A-deficient tumours are examined by clonal lineage tracing combined with parallel multiomics, which resolves transcriptional heterogeneity. STEER-seq extends this logic to pooled multimodal perturbation screening for transcription factors that alter cellular identity. What is new is the coupling of lineage, epigenetic and perturbation readouts at single-cell resolution, although the NMIBC analysis rests on two patients and warrants cautious interpretation.
